examples.text: He declared at 689-7.

glosses: To explicitly establish the existence of (a variable, function, etc.) without necessarily describing its content.

examples.text: The counter "i" was declared as an integer.

glosses: to declare war

examples.text: France declared on me, I'm finished!

glosses: To state that a thing shall happen or affirm a condition in the hopes of seeing it happen spiritually, in contrast to prayer which takes the form of a request.

examples.text: He prayed to God "please heal my sister", while she declared "I am healed in Jesus' name".
